example_en: The children were excited to unwrap their presents.
examples_extra: She unwrapped the gift eagerly.
He quickly unwrapped the sandwich.
note_fa: یعنی باز کردن کادو؛ متضاد wrap.

meaning_en: To open something using a zipper.
example_en: Please unzip your jacket; it's hot.
examples_extra: He unzipped his jacket quickly.
Can you unzip my dress?
note_fa: یعنی زیپ را باز کردن؛ متضاد zip.

meaning_en: With, together, jointly.
example_en: The prefix "com-" appears in words like "combine" and "community."
examples_extra: The prefix com- means with or together.
The words combine and community both start with com-.

meaning_en: To express sympathy or pity for someone.
example_en: We commiserated with him after his team lost.
examples_extra: I sincerely commiserated with him over his loss.
She kindly commiserated with the sadly defeated team.

meaning_en: With, together, or thoroughly.
example_en: The prefix "con-" appears in words like "connect" and "convene."
examples_extra: The prefix con- means with or together.
The verbs contact and connect both start with con-.

meaning_en: To solidify or thicken, especially by cooling.
example_en: The blood began to congeal around the wound.
examples_extra: The fat congealed on top of the soup.
Spilled blood congeals quite quickly outside the body.

meaning_en: Relating to electronic communication or the internet.
example_en: The "e" in e-mail stands for electronic.
examples_extra: E-books are increasingly popular with students these days.
She quickly sent an angry e-mail yesterday.

meaning_en: An electronic device that simulates tobacco smoking.
example_en: Many people use e-cigarettes to quit smoking.
examples_extra: He recently switched to an e-cigarette instead.
E-cigarettes remain highly controversial among many doctors.

meaning_en: Relating to the environment or ecology.
example_en: The prefix "eco-" often refers to environmental concerns.
examples_extra: Eco-friendly products are increasingly popular with shoppers now.
The official eco-label certifies truly green goods.

meaning_en: A city designed to have minimal environmental impact.
example_en: Singapore aims to become a leading eco-city.
examples_extra: The new eco-city runs on solar power.
They are building a model eco-city here.

meaning_en: Not harmful to the environment.
example_en: We buy eco-friendly cleaning products for our home.
examples_extra: We always buy eco-friendly cleaning products now.
This reusable shopping bag is fully eco-friendly.

meaning_en: An activist who campaigns to protect the environment.
example_en: The eco-warrior chained herself to the tree.
examples_extra: The young eco-warrior planted hundreds of trees.
Local eco-warriors protested the new pipeline yesterday.

meaning_en: To force or throw something out suddenly.
example_en: The pilot had to eject from the failing aircraft.
examples_extra: The brave pilot ejected safely from the jet.
They ejected him from the club yesterday.

meaning_en: To send out light, heat, sound, or gas.
example_en: The sun emits vast amounts of energy.
examples_extra: The factory must not emit harmful gases.
The lamp emits a warm, pleasant glow.
note_fa: ساطع کردن؛ بیرون فرستادن نور، گرما یا گاز.

meaning_en: Forms negative adjectives, meaning "not" or "opposite of."
example_en: The prefix "il-" appears in words like "illegal" and "illiterate."
examples_extra: The prefix il- makes negatives like 'illegal'.
Il- appears before l: illogical.
note_fa: پیشوند منفی‌ساز قبل از l: illegal، illiterate.

meaning_en: Forms negative adjectives, meaning "not" or "opposite of."
example_en: The prefix "im-" is found in words like "impossible" and "impatient."
examples_extra: The prefix im- forms words like 'impossible'.
Im- makes negatives before m, p, b.

meaning_en: Not perfect; having flaws or defects.
example_en: Even the most beautiful things can be imperfect.
examples_extra: The system is still imperfect.
We live in an imperfect world.

meaning_en: Forms negative adjectives, meaning "not" or "opposite of."
example_en: The prefix "in-" is used in words like "inactive" and "incomplete."
examples_extra: The prefix in- can mean 'not', as in 'invisible'.
The prefix in- forms negatives like incorrect.

meaning_en: The state of being incorrect or imprecise.
example_en: The report contained several factual inaccuracies.
examples_extra: There is one inaccuracy in the report.
The inaccuracy of the data worried us.

meaning_en: Not suitable or proper for a particular situation.
example_en: His comments were completely inappropriate for the meeting.
examples_extra: He made an inappropriate joke.
Her comments were completely inappropriate.

meaning_en: Not having the ability or skill to do something.
example_en: He seemed incapable of understanding simple instructions.
examples_extra: He seems incapable of sitting still.
She is incapable of lying.
note_fa: incapable of doing یعنی ناتوان از انجام.

meaning_en: A prefix meaning "not" or "opposite of."
example_en: The prefix "ir-" appears in words like "irresponsible" and "irregular."
examples_extra: The prefix ir- means not, as in irregular.
Ir- appears in words like irresponsible.

meaning_en: Indicates error, wrongness, or lack.
example_en: The prefix "mis-" means "wrongly," as in "misunderstand."
examples_extra: The common prefix mis- means wrong or badly.
The verb misunderstand starts with the prefix mis-.

meaning_en: Act badly or improperly.
example_en: The children misbehaved during the school trip.
examples_extra: The bored children misbehaved badly at the party.
He was punished because he would misbehave daily.

meaning_en: Use something incorrectly or for the wrong purpose.
example_en: He misused his authority to gain personal advantage.
examples_extra: He badly misused company funds again last year.
Please don't misuse this expensive equipment here.

meaning_en: More, better, or longer than something else.
example_en: The prefix "out-" often means to surpass or exceed.
examples_extra: The prefix out- means more than.
Outdo uses the prefix out-.

meaning_en: To be greater in number than another group.
example_en: The protesters easily outnumbered the police officers present.
examples_extra: Women outnumber men on campus.
They heavily outnumber us now.

meaning_en: To be more important or significant than something else.
example_en: The benefits of the project outweigh the potential risks.
examples_extra: The benefits outweigh the risks.
The pros outweigh the cons.

meaning_en: Too much, excessively, or above.
example_en: The prefix "over-" often indicates excess or superiority.
examples_extra: The prefix over- means too much.
Overcook uses the prefix over-.

meaning_en: To stick out over something below.
example_en: The cliff face began to overhang the path.
examples_extra: The tall trees overhang our garden.
The roof overhangs the wall.

meaning_en: During the night; suddenly and quickly.
example_en: The situation changed overnight after the announcement.
examples_extra: It all happened overnight somehow.
Overnight snow caused traffic chaos.

meaning_en: Too expensive; costing more than its true value.
meaning_fa: گران قیمت، بیش از حد گران
example_en: The restaurant's food was delicious but very overpriced.
examples_extra: This hotel is quite overpriced.
The restaurant menu is overpriced.

meaning_en: To make something seem less important or successful.
example_en: Her brilliant performance overshadowed everyone else's efforts.
examples_extra: The scandal overshadowed the event.
She felt overshadowed by her sister.

meaning_en: To behave in an unacceptable way.
example_en: His comments overstepped the mark and offended many.
examples_extra: He overstepped the mark yesterday.
Please don't overstep the mark.

meaning_en: In favor of; supporting something.
example_en: She is a pro-democracy activist.
examples_extra: The pro- campaign won the debate.
He voted pro- in the referendum.

meaning_en: To delay or postpone doing something.
example_en: I tend to procrastinate when faced with difficult tasks.
examples_extra: Do not procrastinate over the application.
He procrastinates whenever he faces deadlines.

meaning_en: To produce offspring; to reproduce.
example_en: Animals procreate to ensure the survival of their species.
examples_extra: Most species procreate in spring.
They chose not to procreate.

meaning_en: To increase rapidly in number or amount.
example_en: Rumors about the scandal began to proliferate.
examples_extra: Coffee shops proliferate in the city centre.
Rumours proliferated after the announcement.

meaning_en: Again; back.
example_en: The prefix "re-" means to do something again, like "rewrite."
examples_extra: The prefix re- means again.
Words with re- suggest repetition.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ پیشوند «دوباره»: rewrite، rebuild.

meaning_en: Think about something again, especially to change a decision.
example_en: Please reconsider your decision to leave the company.
examples_extra: Please carefully reconsider your decision.
She reconsidered and wisely stayed.

meaning_en: Develop an area again, especially by demolishing old buildings.
example_en: The city council plans to redevelop the old industrial zone.
examples_extra: They plan to redevelop the area.
The site was redeveloped last year.

meaning_en: to reconsider a decision or plan
example_en: We need to rethink our strategy for market entry.
examples_extra: We need to rethink our marketing strategy.
She needs to rethink her career decision.

meaning_en: Below, beneath, or insufficient.
example_en: The prefix 'under-' often implies something is not enough.
examples_extra: The prefix under- means 'below' or 'too little'.
Under- appears in words like 'underestimate'.

meaning_en: To think something is smaller or less important.
example_en: Never underestimate the power of a good book.
examples_extra: Don't underestimate the strength of your opponent.
We badly underestimated the total costs involved.

meaning_en: Acting secretly and dishonestly.
example_en: His underhand tactics cost him the respect of his colleagues.
examples_extra: That was an underhand trick.
They won by underhand methods.

meaning_en: Important but not obvious; fundamental.
example_en: The underlying cause of the problem was never addressed.
examples_extra: We must address the underlying causes.
The underlying message was clear.

meaning_en: To weaken or damage something gradually.
example_en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
examples_extra: Constant criticism will undermine his confidence.
The scandal undermined the government.

meaning_en: Not having enough employees.
example_en: The hospital ward was severely understaffed during the night shift.
examples_extra: The hospital is dangerously understaffed.
Our small team is seriously understaffed.

meaning_en: Towards a higher position or state.
example_en: The prefix 'up-' often indicates increase or completion.
examples_extra: The prefix up- can suggest a positive change.
Up- appears in words like 'upgrade'.

meaning_en: An improvement or upward trend.
example_en: The economy is showing signs of an upturn.
examples_extra: Sales show a welcome upturn.
The team hopes for an upturn.
